query:
MATCH p = (b:Base)-[:SCCM_IsMappedTo]->(a:SCCM_AdminUser)-[:SCCM_IsAssigned]->(r:SCCM_SecurityRole)
WHERE r.isSecAdminRole = true
RETURN p
name: SCCM Admins Who Can Escalate Other Admins (Requires AdminService Collection w/ SCCM Admin User)
description: Display SCCM administrators assigned a security-admin-capable role (can modify security scopes and roles, and thus escalate other administrators)
